title: The Majestic
description: Residents of a 1950s coastal community mistake an amnesiac screenwriter for a soldier who never returned from the war.

title: Malice
description: Married New Englanders (Nicole Kidman, Bill Pullman) rent the third floor of their home to a suave surgeon (Alec Baldwin) who gets too close.

title: Night Shift
description: A meek man (Henry Winkler), his helper (Michael Keaton) and a hooker (Shelley Long) run a call-girl ring from the city morgue.

title: The Informant!
description: FBI agents receive an unpleasant surprise when they rely on ADM executive Mark Whitacre to gather evidence in their price-fixing case against agribusiness giant Archer Daniels Midland.

title: The Ant Bully
description: Tired of weathering constant attacks on their colony, ants shrink a destructive boy (Zach Tyler Eisen) to their size and sentence him to live among them until he learns the errors of his ways.

title: Ladyhawke
description: A medieval pickpocket (Matthew Broderick) learns the secret of a brooding knight (Rutger Hauer) with a hawk, and a beauty (Michelle Pfeiffer) with a wolf.

title: Barcelona
description: Women and Cold War politics surround a U.S. sales rep (Taylor Nichols) and his Navy-officer cousin (Chris Eigeman) in Spain.

title: Hearts in Atlantis
description: A mysterious man (Anthony Hopkins) with a very rare ability enters the lives of a widow (Hope Davis) and her son (Anton Yelchin) in Connecticut.

title: Black Beauty
description: Based on Anna Sewell's novel about a horse in Victorian England and its often cruel treatment by various owners.

title: Mr. Nanny
description: As a favor to his former trainer (Sherman Hemsley), a retired wrestler (Terry "Hulk" Hogan) takes a job as a computer tycoon's (Austin Pendleton) bodyguard.

title: Ready to Rumble
description: Two die-hard fans vow to help wrestler Jimmy the King make a comeback after a loss destroys what was left of his career.

title: The Hudsucker Proxy
description: A scheming executive promotes a mailroom worker to company president in the 1950s Manhattan.

title: Caddyshack II
description: The snobby president (Robert Stack) of a country club tees off with a self-made man (Jackie Mason) whose daughter wants to join.

title: Beautiful Creatures
description: Teens (Alden Ehrenreich, Alice Englert) in a backwater Southern town encounter a history of family secrets and a curse that looms for one as she approaches her 16th birthday.

title: Lone Star
description: A small-town Texas sheriff (Chris Cooper) investigates when a brutal predecessor's remains surface 40 years after he was supposedly run out of town.

title: Little Children
description: A dissatisfied housewife (Kate Winslet) and the husband (Patrick Wilson) of a documentary filmmaker (Jennifer Connelly) have secret trysts while their spouses are at work.

title: The Spitfire Grill
description: A small-town businessman sends his mousy wife (Marcia Gay Harden) to watch the ex-convict waitress (Alison Elliott) running the local diner for her bedridden boss (Ellen Burstyn).

title: My Blue Heaven
description: Slick mob witness Vinnie (Steve Martin) hides out in suburbia with square FBI man Barney (Rick Moranis).

title: Arthur
description: An irresponsible playboy (Russell Brand) must choose between an arranged marriage that will ensure his future wealth or following his heart with a woman (Greta Gerwig) he truly loves.

title: Arthur
description: A dry British butler (John Gielgud) helps his tippling master (Dudley Moore) choose love with a waitress (Liza Minnelli) or marriage for money.

title: 8 Seconds
description: Lane Frost is a cowboy who rises to become a professional bull-riding champion in the 1980s. Along the way, he endures injuries and the ups and downs of married life.

title: One Crazy Summer
description: A budding cartoonist (John Cusack) helps a singer (Demi Moore) save her family home from a land developer on the island of Nantucket.

title: Monkey Trouble
description: A 9-year-old (Thora Birch) learns her new pet monkey worked as a pickpocket for a Gypsy hustler (Harvey Keitel).

title: Osmosis Jones
description: One white blood cell's race against the biological clock to hunt down and destroy a lethal new virus.

title: Club Paradise
description: A Chicago firefighter (Robin Williams) and a reggae musician (Jimmy Cliff) turn a Caribbean dive into a swinging-singles resort.

title: The Prince of Pennsylvania
description: A teenager (Keanu Reeves) kidnaps his coal-miner father (Fred Ward), hoping his mother (Bonnie Bedelia) will sell their land for the ransom.

title: Michael Collins
description: An Irish freedom fighter (Liam Neeson) engineers the assassinations of British officials following the failed Easter Rising of 1916.

title: Tequila Sunrise
description: A narcotics officer (Kurt Russell) uses a woman (Michelle Pfeiffer) to catch his buddy, a big-time cocaine dealer (Mel Gibson) ready to retire.

title: Best Friends
description: Hollywood screenwriters (Burt Reynolds, Goldie Hawn), happy as lovers, unwisely get married and go east to meet their in-laws.

title: Pleasantville
description: A shy suburban teen and his sister are transported into the black-and-white world of a 1950s TV sitcom.

title: Singles
description: A group of young adults in a Seattle apartment building faces a series of romantic crises and catastrophes.

title: New York Minute
description: An uptight teenager (Ashley Olsen) and her laid-back twin (Mary-Kate Olsen) spend a wild day on the streets of Manhattan.

title: Graffiti Bridge
description: The Kid (Prince) and his rock-club rival (Morris Day) disagree about music in a sequel to the 1984 film "Purple Rain."

title: National Lampoon's Loaded Weapon 1
description: A murdered policewoman's replacement (Emilio Estevez) continues a cocaine-cookie case with her ex-partner (Samuel L. Jackson).

title: My Sister's Keeper
description: A girl (Abigail Breslin) who was conceived as a marrow donor for her gravely ill sister goes to court to seek emancipation and prevent further harvesting of her body tissue.

title: Conspiracy Theory
description: An obsessive New York cabby (Mel Gibson), in love with a government worker (Julia Roberts), learns that one of his suspicions is justified.

title: Funny Farm
description: A sportswriter (Chevy Chase) and his wife (Madolyn Smith) move to a cottage in the country, where he tries to write a novel.

title: The Salton Sea
description: An addict (Val Kilmer) works undercover for two police officers and deals with a sadistic dealer (Vincent D'Onofrio) while trying to find his wife's killers.

title: Undisputed III: Redemption
description: Uri Boyka is an inmate trapped in the toughest prison in the world. He is ready to make his comeback in a lethal boxing competition for a shot at freedom.

title: This Boy's Life
description: A hip 1950s teen (Leonardo DiCaprio) butts heads with his mother's (Ellen Barkin) rude second husband (Robert De Niro).

title: Disorderlies
description: A greedy heir (Anthony Geary) hires three inept, rap-singing orderlies (The Fat Boys) to care for his rich uncle (Ralph Bellamy).

title: The Island of Dr. Moreau
description: An English U.N. negotiator (David Thewlis) becomes stranded in the tropics with a mad scientist (Marlon Brando) who makes half-human beasts.

title: Hooper
description: An upstart (Jan-Michael Vincent) pushes a veteran Hollywood stuntman (Burt Reynolds), daring him to try a new stunt.
